name: How long does it take to build a custom home in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to build a custom home in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a custom home in Southern California varies significantly based on factors like design complexity, size, site conditions, permitting processes, and material availability. Generally, construction can take anywhere from 12 to 24 months, or even longer for very large or intricate projects. This estimate does not include the pre-construction phase, which involves design, engineering, and obtaining necessary permits, often adding another 3 to 6 months. We work to provide a detailed project schedule once the design is finalized.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building a custom home typically takes 12-24 months for construction, plus an additional 3-6 months for design and permitting, depending on complexity and location.
